title: 9.8 A 50W 98%-Efficiency High-Power Wireless-Charging System with an Acoustic Noise-Reduced Ask Modulation Technique and Internal Hybrid Voltage-/Current-Mode ASK Demodulation
problem: High-power wireless charging (Qi MPP >25W) requires frequent and accurate transmitter-receiver (TRX) communication for safety and signal quality, but ASK modulation can introduce acoustic noise in receiver coil; traditional demodulation approaches are inefficient.
motivation: Qi 2.0 with Magnetic Power Profile (MPP) enables >25W wireless charging; robust TRX communication while minimizing acoustic noise and maximizing efficiency is critical for user experience and system safety.
method: 50W Qi wireless power transfer system with acoustic noise-reduced ASK modulation in transmitter and hybrid voltage-/current-mode ASK demodulation in receiver; achieves 98% efficiency with improved communication reliability.
key_novelty: Acoustic noise-reduced ASK modulation combined with hybrid voltage-/current-mode receiver demodulation enables high-power Qi 2.0 compliance at 98% efficiency while eliminating coil acoustic artifacts.
contributions: Acoustic noise-reduced ASK modulation technique for Qi wireless charging
Internal hybrid voltage-/current-mode ASK demodulation improving communication reliability
50W output power supporting Qi MPP standard
baselines: Qi BPP/EPP standards, prior high-power wireless charging solutions
limitations: Specific demodulation performance metrics (SNR, latency) and comparison with competing 50W systems not provided; acoustic noise reduction quantification not detailed.
primary_theme: High-efficiency Qi wireless charging with acoustic noise control
